items: 12V all-in-one inverter charger with built-in MPPT and 120V output
why: ChatGPT treated this as a one-box purchase and showed carded all-in-one units (ACOPOWER, ALLWEI, PowMr). It only warned that some 'inverter chargers', like the Renogy REGO, lack MPPT, which is a reason to pick the right single unit rather than build a set. What decides the choice is a spec check inside one product: it must have built-in MPPT, 120V rather than 230V output, and 12V LiFePO4 support, so the page should compare models and recommend one.
